hooks.command: jq -r .tool_input.file_path | grep -q '/dist/' && { echo 'dist/ is generated by gulp and wiped on every build. Edit src/ instead.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

f=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path); case "$f" in */src/js/*.js) ./node_modules/.bin/jshint "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; */src/sass/*.scss) ./node_modules/.bin/sass --no-source-map src/sass/styles.scss > /dev/null || exit 2;; esac
